751-1753-3286.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4770-5301-6723-7296.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-7444-8164.easyPrerequisites:
Advanced Reconstruction is level 3.
Heartwood Crafter is prepared.
1170-7444-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

34-147-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-6797.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

5231-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5231-7936--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur, adding {R}.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4506-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4506-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5226-7753--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5226-7753--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1739-4200-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1850-5226-7705.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 Moloid creature token.
Repeat.
1850-5226-7705.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

206-513-527.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
206-513-527.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

206-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

465-719-3742-4251-4742.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7236.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Towering Titan.
When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Towering Titan enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

679-2042-2894-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-2042-2894-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Golgari Brownscale. Then, the draw will be replaced by Golgari Brownscale's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Golgari Brownscale from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2363-3375-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

549-1557-1651-5640.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Siren of the Silent Song, targeting Siren of the Silent Song.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat
549-1557-1651-5640.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

413-3234-3293-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
413-3234-3293-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When World Shaper enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat
413-3234-3293-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1562-4375-5315.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Machine God's Effigy enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Machine God's Effigy.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-3875-5700-5701-6763.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3875-5700-5701-6763.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1235-2239.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Ardent Elementalist with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Ardent Elementalist token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

3719-5256-6188-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures, excluding Fear of Missing Out, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Fear of Missing Out or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
3719-5256-6188-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Luxurious Locomotive and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

2781-3967-5987.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Angel of Indemnity.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all abilities from step 3, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.

465-618-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token, adding {R}.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1124-2696-2937.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature and/or a land that can tap to produce at least {5}.
You control at least four creatures.
1124-2696-2937.description:
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil and the creature and/or land that can produce at least {5}, and causing you to gain two life.
Activate the creature and/or land by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing each Planeswalker to activate their loyalty abilities an extra time this turn.
Repeat.
Activate Xenagos' first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R} or {G} for each creature you control.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of each of your planeswalkers this turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil and up to one other creature or land you control, and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
1124-2696-2937.notes: If you control five or more creatures, this combo will net infinite mana, and you may then activate any of Xenagos' other abilities. You may also tap any other creature and/or land to reduce this cost and/or gain more mana, and untap them via Teferi.

1636-1806-3430-5168-5769.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one permanent of each color.
1636-1806-3430-5168-5769.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding three mana of each color.
Activate Legacy Weapon by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, exiling Eternal Scourge.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
When Eternal Scourge enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

562-1723-2512.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Starlit Sanctum's second ability by paying {W}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

2743-2882.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four nontoken creatures.
2743-2882.description:
Cast Infinite Reflection by paying {5}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Infinite Reflection enters the battlefield, causing each nontoken creature you control to become a copy of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

2316-4772-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4772-5231.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.
